{{Quote|Yes, it's real. I had it imported from my homeworld. The forest valleys of Shili are very dear to me.|[[Sheel Mafeen]] to [[Pol Haus]], who is admiring her wooden furniture|<ref name="The Last Jedi (novel)">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>}}
'''Shili''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] located in the [[Ehosiq sector/Legends|Ehosiq sector]].

==History==
[[File:PloDiscoversAhsoka.png|thumb|left|200px|Plo Koon discovering Ahsoka Tano on Shili.]]
The legendary [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] was a native of Shili, as were [[Raana Tey]],<ref name="KOTORH">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref> [[Ashla (Jedi)/Legends|Ashla]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="TCW639">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.39|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.39]]</ref> The planet was a long-time member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutas]] had been in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] since its earliest [[Standard year/Legends|years]].

It was the [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]] of many beasts, such as the [[Akul/Legends|akul]],<ref name="TNEGAS" /> which tribes of Togruta had to work together to defeat in order to survive. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was covered with [[turu-grass]] scrublands and valley canopy forests. The most prominent city on Shili was [[Corvala]], which was the capital. Shili was located in the
Expansion Region<ref name="TNEGAS" /> near the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="EAOC" />

On a mission to Shili, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] found a young [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] who had [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|potential]] and brought her to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TCWVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> This Togruta was Ahsoka Tano, who became the [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="TCW639" />

After the Clone Wars, [[Kajin Savaros]] was sent there among the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] healers and [[The Silent]] to heal after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Probus Tesla]] attempted to brainwash him.<ref name="CNIII">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>
